$comment: Hosts reviewed and retired as non-sources: search/EPG/news/betting/stats/app-store pages that can never be a stream. Merged with the builtin plumbing in source_learning.NON_SOURCE_DOMAINS by load_non_source_domains(); a configured host and every subdomain are refused by discover_candidates and approve_source. Grouped, not flat, because the reason a host is retired is the reviewable part. Evidence: the 2026-11-27 committed run log has thousands of attempts and 0 creates across these hosts, and no entry is an approved host or inside one.

groups.reason: Electronic programme guides and "where to watch" pages: they list broadcasts, they are never the broadcast. 0 creates in the committed ledger.
Betting and tipster sites: never a stream, and their "free" claims are advertising. 0 creates in the committed ledger.
News articles about games, not games. 0 creates in the committed ledger.
Social platforms, app-store listings and video-conference tools: never a promotable stream source.
Score and fixture sites: at most evidence for a fixture, never a directLink. 0 creates in the committed ledger.

Unauthorised stream aggregators and "free live stream" sites: they redistribute other broadcasters' feeds, are never an official source, and a link there cannot be validated as free-and-legal. Verified by fetching each page 2026-11-27.
Sites that matched a query on a club name but are a different business (ALBA the coffee/cosmetics brand, a football or volleyball club). Fetched 2026-11-27: none carries basketball.
Public-sector portals a query reached because a game was mentioned on them. They publish nothing and, measured on 2026-11-27, two of them no longer resolve at all. 0 creates in the committed ledger.
